notes.title: Exclusive playtest
notes.notes:
🍻 Welcome to the Beer Factory Playtest - Your Brewing Adventure Begins! 🍻

[b]Hey there, Craft Beer Enthusiasts and Master Brewers![/b]
We're excited to invite you to the exclusive playtest of Beer Factory! This is a unique opportunity to get a first-hand look at our brewing universe before the full game's release on January 10th.

[b]What to Expect in the Playtest 🌟[/b]
[list]
[*] Early Access to Beer Factory: Jump into the game and get a taste of the brewing life ahead of everyone else.
[*] Exclusive Playthrough of the First Part: Experience the initial stages of the game, where your journey as a brewmaster begins.
[*] Deep Dive into New Content: Explore in-depth the new features and mechanics we've lovingly crafted for you.
[*] Provide Valuable Feedback: Your insights on this early section are crucial. Share your thoughts and help us refine the final experience.
[*] Keep Your Progress 🔄
[*] All the progress you make during the playtest will be saved! You can transfer your save file to the full game, ensuring a smooth continuation of your brewing journey.
[/list]

[b]Joining the Playtest is Easy! 🎮[/b]
[olist]
[*] Head over to the Beer Factory Steam page.
[*] Click on "Request Access" for the playtest.
[/olist]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782570/Beer_Factory/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/59dbfe4ed0bfcf363b4ccd270e5a8eff40f6ee25.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Once you're in, download the game and start your brewing adventure!
[*] We're Listening 📢
[*] Your feedback is a key ingredient in our brewing process. As you play, let us know your experiences, ideas, and any bugs you encounter. Your input is invaluable in perfecting Beer Factory for its grand release.
[/list]

[b]Save the Date 📅[/b]
Remember, the full version of Beer Factory is brewing up for a release on [b]January 10th[/b]. Get ready for an immersive brewing experience!

[b]Stay in the Loop 🌐[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/cfg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/8c60d1d61e82e84b01f77d86f4fdb8b17cc9271a.png[/img][/url]

[b]Cheers to Your Brewing Adventure! 🎉[/b]

notes.title: Playtests announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Brewers,[/b]

We're excited to announce our upcoming playtest scheduled for tomorrow, January 3, 2024! However, we want to clarify that the playtest's content will be limited to the prologue portion of the game.

[b]What to Expect:[/b]

[list]
[*] Early access to the game.
[*] Exclusive playthrough of first part of the game.
[*] An opportunity to explore the new content in-deph.
[*] The chance to provide feedback on this early section of the game.
[/list]

While the playtest will focus solely on the prologue, please rest assured that it will give you a comprehensive preview of what's to come in the full game. Your feedback during this stage is invaluable in helping us shape the overall gaming experience.

To participate, ensure you're registered with us, and watch your inbox and Steam notifications for further instructions on how to access the playtest.

Thank you for being a part of this exciting journey as we refine and develop our game. We can't wait to see you in action and hear your thoughts!

Best regards,

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
[b]Fantastic Beer Enthusiasts![/b]

With great joy, we announce today the most anticipated moment in the history of virtual brewing. Our Beer Factory, an incredible simulation game where you have the chance to become a true brewing magnate, now has its release date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/1a021c1002bf52776c48c75bbf5ddde20ea48598.png[/img]

Very soon, on January 10, 2024, we will open the gates of our virtual beer factory for your creativity and entrepreneurship. Get ready with your mugs because it will be an unforgettable journey through the land of aromatic hops, crunchy malt, and fermentation magic!

Beer Factory will transport you into the fascinating world of brewing challenges, where every decisive click brings you closer to becoming a true brewing magnate. You will design unique recipes, ensure the highest quality ingredients, manage production, all with the aim of winning the hearts of beer enthusiasts from around the world.

Prepare for countless opportunities to perfect your brewery, meet brewing experts, and participate in exclusive industry events. Beer Factory is not just a game; it's a journey through the land of brewing dreams!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782570/Beer_Factory/

We invite you to our beery world on January 10, 2024, on the Steam platform. It will be a time when your beer passions receive digital wings. Explore the secrets of the art of brewing, experiment with recipes, and conquer the world with your one-of-a-kind brew!

We can't wait for you to join us on this fantastic beer empire adventure. See you on Steam, Beer Enthusiasts! Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: SIGN UP for playtests
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43366825/946a722aea8c9c34b7a74b0de47f901b12ab21fd.png[/img]

[b]🍻 Greetings, Brewery Workers! 🍻[/b]

We have some exciting news from the production line of our game! Today, we are thrilled to announce that we are nearing a major event: the playtests of "Beer Factory"! It's you who will have the opportunity to join this extraordinary adventure and help us refine our game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782570/Beer_Factory/

Since you stepped into our virtual brewery, we have been tirelessly working on our game, paying attention to every detail, aiming to create the most captivating and realistic brewery simulation.

Playtests are crucial for us, as they will allow you to experience "Beer Factory" firsthand. We want to hear your opinions, suggestions, and feedback to help us perfect our game. Your input will make our production an unforgettable experience.

To participate in the playtests, simply visit our Steam page and sign up for the program. [i]It's as easy as pouring a beer into a glass![/i] 😉 Soon, we will grant access to the game, and you'll have the chance to let us know what you think.

[h3]Sign up for the playtests now! [/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782570/Beer_Factory/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43366825/737b7a8cdab2e4bde039e07e1f77cbe203cf0e7a.png[/img][/url]

If you're ready for the challenge and want to see if you have what it takes to create the best brewery in history, this is your chance. Prepare yourself for production, recipe refinement, and competing with other brewmasters.

We thank you for your support and trust that you've bestowed upon us. [b]Together, we will craft the finest brewery in the world of gaming![/b]

We appreciate your assistance in advance and can't wait for you to experience what we've prepared. Take care, and we'll see you in our Brewery soon!

Cheers! 🍻
The Beer Factory Team

notes.title: Small update 30.03.2023
notes.notes:
[b]New changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Staying around the employee does not prevent him from working anymore, you have to look at him to make him stop
[*] The door of the fusebox close when the fuse is turned up
[*] Default steering speed 0.6 -> 0.75
[*] Added key mapping to the save system
[*] Improved the detection of the trucks and the pickup with Francis
[*] Forklift consume less
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made a pallet appear over and over again in front of the factory
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes allowed to increase the speed of the conveyors to more than 20x the normal speed instead of the maximum of 2
[*] Fixed a bug that totally blocked the employee under certain conditions
[*] Fixed a bug that gave the animation to the employee that he has when he carries the garbage when he was assigned to a workstation
[*] Fixed a bug that gave access to a debug interface
[/list]

notes.title: Small update 21.03.2023
notes.notes:
New change:

[list]
[*] The type of interaction between the objects in the hand and those in the environment has changed. For example, now the bags are not automatically placed on the pallets, they have to be dropped or thrown.
[/list]

Bugs fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that triggered the call of the accountant when playing the Francis cinematic.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the coffee cup appear before making one.
[*] Fixed the fact that the orange pickup could be moved with the forklift.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented to pass the level 3 objective if you had already passed the objective in advance.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to block a trash bag in the corner of the dumpster.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to throw objects outside the game zone.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to get static bags out of the pallets by placing the pallet on the running conveyors.
[/list]

notes.title: Small update 17.03.2023
notes.notes:
New changes: 

[list]
[*] Visual improvement in the help menu.
[*] Added a quick objective to open the factory doors to show players who were not paying attention, that it could be opened
[*] Added a help that appears when you stand idle (The game assumes that you are looking for an object to interact with)
[/list]
Fixes :

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred before the video at the end of the demo
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the introduction from being displayed
[/list]

notes.title: Small update 16.03.2023
notes.notes:
New changes

[list]
[*] Added the possibility to choose if you whant encounter Francis or not when you make a new game
[*] Added the possibility to choose which axis you want to invert or not
[*] Default steering speed changed from 1 -> 0.6
[/list]

Bugs fix

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to buy the machinery room 2
[*] Fixed the eyes texture of the character on the forklift
[/list]

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed several bugs that allowed passing outside the game area
[*] We can now take the bags that have passed through the yellow pickup
[/list]

notes.title: Small update 15.03.2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a slider in the controls settings to change the value of the mouse and controller sensibility
[*] Added an option to inverse the camera axis in the controls settings
[*] Added a slider in the controls settings to change the value of the steering speed for the forklift
[/list]

notes.title: Small update 14.03.2023
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone. In the feedbacks you told me that you had a headache because of the motion blur. You can now disable it in the settings.
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the possibility to enable or disable the motion blur
[*] Added the possibility to change the field of view
[/list]
